## Summary

Data analyst with a background spanning BI infrastructure, data engineering, and people analytics. Combines hands-on experience building production dbt/SQL pipelines and BI dashboards with graduate training in Industrial/Organizational Psychology and hands-on work designing and statistically validating talent assessments. Comfortable moving between engineering (Snowflake, dbt, Power BI) and the statistical/psychometric rigor (reliability, validity, significance testing) that people analytics work specifically demands.

## Skills

- **Technical:** Python, R, SQL, dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery, Power BI, Alteryx, Streamlit, Looker
- **AI Tools:** GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, Cortex
- **Statistical / Psychometric:** Reliability and validity testing, t-tests, ANOVA, correlation, regression, Fisher's Z transformation, assessment design and weighting
- **Domain:** People analytics, talent assessment, BI infrastructure, data governance, survey methodology
